# The documentation a pull request may change and still skip the code's checks (decision
# 70): when every file it changes is matched here, CI's lint, clippy and tests are
# skipped. CI's `platforms` job and tools/check-docs-paths.sh both read this file.
#
# One glob a line, matched as git's glob pathspecs, from the repository's root: `*` stays
# within a folder, `**` crosses folders. A `!` line takes files out again. A `#` starts
# a comment.
#
# Never the Markdown that code or tests read (tools/check-docs-paths.sh fails on it),
# nor anything under crates/, nor LICENSE, data/, the locales or images: they are the
# code's inputs.

docs/**
*.md
.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/**
.github/pull_request_template.md

# Embedded in the About box, and checked by the icons' test.
!CREDITS.md
